arsinoitherium.note: The data source gives no name for this creature (code 05865dc2), seen once, at level 6 (the Rare starting level), so it is a Common or Rare. The feed names creatures up to game version 3.20 (Paralititan, Shantrospinos, Paralitrosaurus and Coelocephalus are all named), so a creature with no name at all is from 3.21 or later, and Arsinoitherium (3.22) is the only Rare or Common added since then.

It is Indoraptor Mattel: its levels (26-32) are Apex levels, and in the Coin Tournament's alphabetical list of eligible Apex creatures it sits between Indochicyon and Kentrorex. Of the three Apex creatures in that spot, Indolycan and Indonemys appear in the feed under their own names, leaving Indoraptor Mattel (game version 3.22, newer than the feed's name list).

pelorosuchus.note: The data source gives no name for this creature (code 2b88a0f8, first seen 9 October 2026). It is Pelorosuchus: it was used in the Cash Tournament, which allowed only Legendary and Omega creatures, and none of its 74 copies has omega training, so it is a Legendary (its lowest level, 16, is the Legendary starting level). The feed has names for every creature up to game version 3.20 and internal names for 3.21-3.22, so a creature with no name at all is newer. When it appeared, Pelorosuchus (released 29 September in 3.23) was the only such Legendary in the game's creature list. Erlidraco, another 3.23 Legendary, was only added to the list after 10 October and is fused from Guidraco, which the feed had not seen even a week later.
